title: Measuring and Improving BERT's Mathematical Abilities by Predicting the Order of Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mathematical reasoning capabilities of BERT, a large language model. It investigates positional and other biases in this context. There are no components dedicated to evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics. The Impact Statement discusses potential negative consequences of model errors, but this does not constitute a core research theme.
